caption: The video showcases two clear drinking glasses set side by side on a white surface against a sheet of printed text. The left glass holds yellow liquid with a thin orange layer at its base. The right glass contains a smaller volume of green liquid. A black ribbed bendy straw arches over both rims, its ends submerged, with a white concentric-circle graphic hovering near the apex. Across the excerpt the yellow surface in the left glass and the green surface in the right glass remain at essentially the same heights. No clearly visible transfer of liquid occurs between the two columns. The orange layer and a small droplet clinging to the upper-left rim stay in place, and the straw keeps its arched shape. The white overlay pulses gently, expanding and contracting, while the camera stays largely still.
